story.text: 국제시장 골목은 없는 게 없었다. 옷가게, 신발가게를 지나 액세서리 노점 앞에서 나는 예쁜 팔찌 하나에 눈이 팔렸다.
story.reading: guk-je-si-jang gol-mog-eun eop-neun ge eop-seot-da. ot-ga-ge, sin-bal-ga-ge-reul ji-na-seo aek-se-seo-ri no-jeom ap-e-seo na-neun ye-ppeun pal-jji ha-na-e nun-i pal-lyeot-da.
story.en: The alleys of Gukje Market seemed to sell everything under the sun. Passing clothing shops and shoe stalls, I found myself drawn to a pretty bracelet at an accessories stand.

story.text: 잠깐 화장실 좀 다녀오겠다며 용우가 자리를 비웠다. 평소보다 오래 걸린다 싶었는데, 돌아온 그의 손엔 작은 종이봉투 하나가 들려 있었다.
story.reading: jam-kkan hwa-jang-sil jom da-nyeo-o-get-da-myeo yong-u-ga ja-ri-reul bi-wot-da. pyeong-so-bo-da o-rae geol-lin-da sip-eoss-neun-de, dol-a-on geu-ui son-en jak-eun jong-i-bong-tu ha-na-ga deul-lyeo iss-eot-da.
story.en: Saying he'd be right back from the restroom, Yongwoo stepped away. It took him longer than usual, and when he came back, there was a small paper bag in his hand.

story.text: '그건 뭐예요?' 물으니 용우가 봉투를 슬쩍 등 뒤로 감춘다. '아무것도 아니다. 그냥 산 거다.'
story.reading: geu-geon mwo-ye-yo? mul-eu-ni yong-u-ga bong-tu-reul seul-jjak deung dwi-ro gam-chun-da. a-mu-geot-do a-ni-da. geu-nyang san geo-da.
story.en: 'What's that?' I asked, and Yongwoo tucked the bag behind his back. 'It's nothing. Just something I bought.'

story.text: '뭔데 그렇게 숨겨요?' '됐고, 신경 꺼. …자, 다음 가게나 가자.' 서둘러 화제를 돌리며 앞장서 걷는 모습이 왠지 수상했다.
story.reading: mwon-de geu-reo-ke sum-gyeo-yo? dwaet-go, sin-gyeong kkeo. ja, da-eum ga-ge-na ga-ja. seo-dul-leo hwa-je-reul dol-li-myeo ap-jang-seo geot-neun mo-seub-i waen-ji su-sang-haet-da.
story.en: 'Why are you hiding it like that?' 'Never mind, don't worry about it. ...Come on, next shop.' The way he hurried to change the subject and walk ahead felt more than a little suspicious.

story.text: 저녁 무렵, 숙소로 가는 길에 용우가 몰래 종이봉투 속을 한 번 더 들여다보는 걸 봤다. 별거 아니라던 것치고 표정이 꽤 만족스러워 보였다.
story.reading: jeo-nyeok mu-ryeop, suk-so-ro ga-neun gil-e yong-u-ga mol-lae jong-i-bong-tu sog-eul han beon deo deul-yeo-da-bo-neun geol bwat-da. byeol-geo a-ni-ra-deon geot-chi-go pyo-jeong-i kkwae man-jok-seu-reo-wo bo-yeot-da.
story.en: That evening, on the way back, I caught Yongwoo secretly peeking into the paper bag one more time. For something he'd claimed was nothing, he looked awfully pleased with himself.

story.text: '뭐 좋은 거라도 샀어요?' 묻자 화들짝 봉투를 가방 깊숙이 넣는다. '아니라니까. …쓸데없는 거 신경 쓰지 말고 밥이나 먹으러 가자.'
story.reading: mwo jo-eun geo-ra-do sass-eo-yo? mut-ja hwa-deul-jjak bong-tu-reul ga-bang gip-sug-i neon-neun-da. a-ni-ra-ni-kka. sseul-de-eop-neun geo sin-gyeong sseu-ji mal-go bap-i-na meog-eu-reo ga-ja.
story.en: 'Did you buy something good?' I asked, and he jolted, shoving the bag deep into his backpack. 'I said it's nothing. ...Stop worrying about pointless things and let's go get dinner.'

story.text: 궁금증은 접어두기로 했다. 언젠가는 알게 되겠지 싶어서. '오늘 시장 대화들도 몇 개 들어봐라. 재밌는 것들 많다.'
story.reading: gung-geum-jeung-eun jeob-eo-du-gi-ro haet-da. eon-jen-ga-neun al-ge doe-get-ji sip-eo-seo. o-neul si-jang dae-hwa-deul-do myeot gae deul-eo-bwa-ra. jae-mi-neun geot-deul man-ta.
story.en: I decided to let my curiosity rest — figured I'd find out eventually. 'Listen to a few market conversations today too. There are some fun ones.'

words.example_en: I browsed accessories at the street stall.

words.example: 그의 손에 작은 종이봉투가 들려 있었다.
words.example_reading: geu-ui son-e jak-eun jong-i-bong-tu-ga deul-lyeo iss-eot-da
words.example_en: There was a small paper bag in his hand.
He secretly peeked into the bag.

sentences.ko: 국제시장 골목은 없는 게 없을 만큼 다양한 노점들로 가득했다.
sentences.reading: guk-je-si-jang gol-mog-eun eop-neun ge eop-seul man-keum da-yang-han no-jeom-deul-lo ga-deuk-aet-da
sentences.en: The alleys of Gukje Market were packed with all kinds of street stalls, selling seemingly everything.

sentences.ko: 잠깐 자리를 비웠다 돌아온 그의 손엔 작은 종이봉투가 들려 있었다.
sentences.reading: jam-kkan ja-ri-reul bi-wot-da dol-a-on geu-ui son-en jak-eun jong-i-bong-tu-ga deul-lyeo iss-eot-da
sentences.en: When he came back after stepping away for a moment, there was a small paper bag in his hand.

sentences.ko: 뭐냐고 묻자 그는 서둘러 화제를 돌리며 앞장서 걸었다.
sentences.reading: mwo-nya-go mut-ja geu-neun seo-dul-leo hwa-je-reul dol-li-myeo ap-jang-seo geol-eot-da
sentences.en: Asked what it was, he hurriedly changed the subject and walked on ahead.

sentences.ko: 숙소로 가는 길, 그가 몰래 봉투 속을 들여다보는 걸 보고 말았다.
sentences.reading: suk-so-ro ga-neun gil, geu-ga mol-lae bong-tu sog-eul deul-yeo-da-bo-neun geol bo-go mal-at-da
sentences.en: On the way back, I caught him secretly peeking into the bag.

sentences.ko: 별거 아니라던 것치고 그의 표정은 꽤 만족스러워 보였다.
sentences.reading: byeol-geo a-ni-ra-deon geot-chi-go geu-ui pyo-jeong-eun kkwae man-jok-seu-reo-wo bo-yeot-da
sentences.en: For something he claimed was nothing, his expression looked quite satisfied.

turns.speaker: 손님
turns.text: 화장실 갔다 온다면서 왜 이렇게 오래 걸렸어요?
turns.reading: hwa-jang-sil gat-da on-da-myeon-seo wae i-reo-ke o-rae geol-lyeoss-eo-yo?
turns.en: You said you were just going to the restroom, why'd it take so long?

turns.speaker: 권용우 기장
turns.en: ...The line was a bit long. Nothing much.

turns.speaker: 손님
turns.text: 근데 그 봉투는 뭐예요? 화장실 갔다 오는데 쇼핑도 했어요?
turns.reading: geun-de geu bong-tu-neun mwo-ye-yo? hwa-jang-sil gat-da o-neun-de syo-ping-do haess-eo-yo?
turns.en: But what's that bag? Did you shop on the way to the restroom too?

turns.speaker: 권용우 기장
turns.text: 아, 이거. …그냥 지나가다 산 거다. 신경 쓸 거 없다.
turns.reading: a, i-geo. geu-nyang ji-na-ga-da san geo-da. sin-gyeong sseul geo eop-da.
turns.en: Ah, this. ...Just something I bought passing by. Nothing to worry about.

dialogues.question: 용우가 종이봉투에 든 물건을 숨기는 이유로 가장 알맞은 것은?
dialogues.question_en: What best explains why Yongwoo is hiding what's in the paper bag?
dialogues.correct_answer: 깜짝 선물처럼 준비한 것이라 미리 들키고 싶지 않아서
options: 깜짝 선물처럼 준비한 것이라 미리 들키고 싶지 않아서
dialogues.explanation: 용우는 손님을 위해 몰래 준비한 것을 미리 들키고 싶지 않아, 별거 아니라고 얼버무렸습니다.

turns.speaker: 손님
turns.text: 아까부터 봉투를 계속 신경 쓰시던데요. 뭐가 들었길래요?
turns.reading: a-kka-bu-teo bong-tu-reul gye-sok sin-gyeong sseu-si-deon-de-yo. mwo-ga deul-eot-gil-lae-yo?
turns.en: You've been keeping an eye on that bag this whole time. What's inside?

turns.speaker: 권용우 기장
turns.text: 신경은 무슨. 그냥 잘 산 건가 확인한 거다.
turns.reading: sin-gyeong-eun mu-seun. geu-nyang jal san geon-ga hwak-in-han geo-da.
turns.en: What do you mean, keeping an eye on it. Just checking if I bought it right.

turns.speaker: 손님
turns.text: 표정 보니까 뭔가 마음에 쏙 든 것 같은데요.
turns.reading: pyo-jeong bo-ni-kka mwon-ga ma-eum-e ssok deun geot gat-eun-de-yo.
turns.en: From your face, it looks like you're really pleased with it.

turns.speaker: 권용우 기장
turns.text: …티 났나. 아무튼 지금은 말 안 해줄 거다. 궁금하면 좀 참아라.
turns.reading: ti nan-na. a-mu-teun ji-geum-eun mal an hae-jul geo-da. gung-geum-ha-myeon jom cham-a-ra.
turns.en: ...Was it that obvious. Anyway, I'm not telling you right now. If you're curious, just wait.

dialogues.question: 이 대화에서 용우의 태도로 가장 알맞은 설명은?
dialogues.question_en: What best describes Yongwoo's attitude in this conversation?
dialogues.correct_answer: 준비한 것에 스스로도 만족하면서, 정체는 끝까지 비밀로 하려 한다
options: 준비한 것에 스스로도 만족하면서, 정체는 끝까지 비밀로 하려 한다
산 물건이 마음에 안 들어서 후회하고 있다
dialogues.explanation: 용우는 자신이 준비한 것에 스스로 만족스러워하면서도, 그 정체는 끝까지 비밀로 하려는 모습을 보였습니다.
